I never went to school, so I farm the way my father taught me and I copy what my neighbors do. This sorghum plot is very small, only 0.12 hectares, and it is rented land, so I will not spend my little cash on fertilizer or improved seed for it. I will plant the sorghum seed I saved from last year, and I will weed it with my own hands and my family's hands. I cannot afford to hire workers for such a small plot, and sorghum grows fine without those chemicals if the rain comes.
